conviction_note: A mild negative lean. One broker (SB1 Markets, 2026-10-07) has Q3 EBITA at SEK 56m, about 27% below a consensus of roughly SEK 77m, and Finnish and Middle East peer evidence backs it, while Swedish peers (Sweco Sverige, AFRY) printed better utilisation. Since the 2026-10-19 EGMs the Multiconsult/Rejlers exchange-ratio spread is near 0, so Rejlers B now trades as 46% of the combined group. Multiconsult (54%) and Norconsult report the same morning, which dilutes Rejlers' own surprise and adds news nobody here can sign. Result: abs_move 4.0 with p_up 44 gives -0.48, close to the findings' sum of -0.6.

findings.finding: SB1 Markets sees Q3 EBITA at SEK 56m (5.1% margin), about 27% below a consensus of roughly 77m, which sits above last year's record 73.6m even though H1 EBITA fell 6% y/y. The drags it cites (Finland, Abu Dhabi, low utilisation) are corroborated by Etteplan's Q3, which reports a July Middle East escalation and weak Finnish demand.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2 2026 (EBITA flat y/y, margin down) rose +3.2% on a midday release. Q3 2025 (record EBITA) +0.1%. Q1 2026 -2.26%. Q4 2025 -2.6%. Q3 2024 +10.2%. Median absolute reaction about 2.3% over 11 observed report dates
findings.original_quote: Svag utveckling i Finland och Abu Dhabi samt låg beläggning väntas tynga. (Weak development in Finland and Abu Dhabi and low utilisation are expected to weigh.) SB1's EBITA forecast of 56 MSEK is about 27 percent below consensus.
findings.why_not_priced: If the market had taken SB1's view, consensus would have been cut toward 56m and the stock would have lagged Multiconsult. Instead the spread to Multiconsult closed and the stock rose from 136 to 152 since the note, so the price follows the merger arbitrage, not Rejlers' standalone quarter. The consensus quoted is still about 77m.
findings.independence: Etteplan Q3 2026 (29.10.2026): 'heinäkuussa kärjistynyt Lähi-idän kriisi käänsi asiakkaitamme jälleen odottavalle kannalle, ja esimerkiksi Suomessa lomautusten määrä kääntyi kasvuun' (the Middle East crisis that escalated in July again put our customers in wait-and-see mode, and in Finland layoffs started rising again), https://mb.cision.com/Main/11766/4417058/4344486.pdf. Also Rejlers' own H1 report on Abu Dhabi (-9m y/y in Q2) and Finland, https://attachment.news.eu.nasdaq.com/ab2c555dd6e68e0df4dd7fe6e0b8e7a97

findings.finding: Swedish peers printed better Q3 utilisation. Sweco Sverige EBITA margin rose to 8.9% from 6.7% on a higher billing rate and fees, the group beat consensus at 786m against 767m, and AFRY reported improved utilisation and a record backlog. Sweden is about 65% of Rejlers' sales and posted 11% organic growth in Q2.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Rejlers fell 0.8% on 2026-10-29, the day of Sweco's beat, and rose 2.7% on 2026-10-22 (AFRY day) while the OMX fell. Peer read-through has not visibly moved it
findings.original_quote: Resultatet förbättrades främst till följd av högre debiteringsgrad och högre genomsnittliga arvoden. (The result improved mainly because of a higher billing rate and higher average fees.)
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced. It is a public peer print, and an analyst who sees SB1's 56m has also seen Sweco. Kept small: it is a proxy, and Rejlers' problems sit in Finland and Abu Dhabi, not Sweden. Net of the rest of the company, Sweden has to offset those two.
findings.independence: AFRY Q3 2026: 'stable results for the third quarter, with an improved utilization rate and a strong order backlog', https://www.inderes.se/releases/afry-interim-report-january-september-2026

findings.finding: The costs of the northern Sweden Buildings ramp (125 hires: 12m in Q1, 6m in Q2) are fading, and the company says the ramp is progressing 'faster than planned'. That supports a Q3 Sweden margin above Q2, but it sits inside what management already told the market (target margins from Q1 2027).
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2 2026, when the ramp cost fell from 12m to 6m, rose +3.2%
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced. It is the company's own guidance and every estimate has it, so it is sized near 0.

findings.finding: Rejlers B is effectively the combined Multiconsult Rejlers share: Multiconsult (54% of the combined group) reports Q3 at 08:30 CET the same morning, and the exchange-ratio spread has been near 0 since the EGM approvals. Over the window Rejlers will trade on both prints (plus Norconsult's, 07:00), and Rejlers' own surprise reaches its price at about 46% weight.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No prior combined print. The spread moved 2-4 points in single days in October (for example 2026-10-06 and 2026-10-15), so Rejlers can diverge from Multiconsult intraday before arbitrage closes the gap
findings.why_not_priced: Not a directional fact: it sets the size of the move, not its sign. It is filed so that abs_move and the dilution of the Rejlers-specific finding can be audited.

baseline_tension: Agrees mildly with the -0.53 priced lean. The +10.6% run-up is merger-arbitrage convergence after the EGMs, not earnings anticipation, so it neither confirms nor refutes the quarter lean.
language_note: The SB1 Markets Q3 forecast (EBITA 56m, about 27% below consensus, buy with target price 190) appeared only in Swedish Finwire copy on Placera; no English source carried the forecast or the consensus comparison.

Etteplan's Finnish-language Q3 text was where I found the July Middle East escalation and rising Finnish layoffs; the English version of the same report carries the same facts, so this half added nothing new.
Sweco Sverige's segment margin (8.9% against 6.7%) and the billing-rate explanation came from the Swedish TT/Via release.
Rejlers' own filings (H1 report, merger plan, EGM bulletin) were bilingual and carried nothing extra in Swedish.
lessons_applied: Bar is one source and contested ('bar unsourced or disputed'): the SB1 finding goes from -1.3 to -1.2 and p_up from 42 to 44.
Proxy rule (a narrow proxy loses): the Sweco/AFRY read-through goes from +0.6 to +0.5.
Finding inside company guidance (ramp costs, target margins from Q1 2027): +0.2 to +0.1.
Positioning: the FI zero is restated as a truncated zero with anchor_covered false, not as evidence of no shorts.

'In a live bid, results are noise': this is a stock-for-stock merger of equals, not a cash bid, so the share is not pinned. The rule is applied partially, through the 46% dilution in the structural finding. abs_move is kept at 4.0 rather than cut, because the lessons also say the move is systematically understated.
